lines.en: It was a hot January night in spring.
Yeah, I know.
I promise, things will get better though. This isn’t one of those events that begins with some sort of transient, melancholic monologue you’d need to lobotomize yourself to understand.
This is one of the good nights.
The kind that you look back on and think, “Huh...I guess there was a time when I was truly happy.”
Because, maybe it’s just me, but you stop forming those memories once you get a little older.

So those moments you spent with your friends back when your hands were smaller sort of linger there forever — eternally locked in the closet of your mind, opened only when you’re looking for an old shirt or keys or-
Sorry. I’ll stop. I promised this wouldn’t get melancholic and I intend to keep my word despite the many other times in which I’ve deceived you.
That backstory goes like this — a pipe burst on the 56th floor of the infinite dorm building. Everything flooded.

And, not wanting to bathe alongside their cherished possessions and anything that may have floated out of the abyss that is dorm seven, a handful of the girls from Class 1-A decided to come bathe here.
A certain someone was not very happy about this.
: I do not like this at all.
That certain someone was Io Ichimonji. Everyone else was fine, though.
: Don’t worry, we won’t bother you. There’s no one in the men’s bath right now, is there? I’d like to rent out the whole section for the rest of the night.
: That’ll be 5,000,000 yen.
: Sure. There should be enough money on this.
: Sorry. I meant 10,000,000. Weekend price.
: This should still be okay.
: How much fucking money can there be in unpoppable bubble wrap?!
: Are you sure you’re okay paying for all of us, Ayane? I can chip in now that I’m a supervisor. I’m no longer poor Rin. I’ve graduated from that and would like to go by financially stable Rin now.
: Well, financially stable Rin, it’s fine. It’s technically my dad’s money anyway. But hey, if you have your mom’s credit card, we can always make our parents go halfsies!
: I’m pretty sure I make more than my mom. All she does is walk around the school and check on the ropes. That’s all she learned how to do before Sensei left.
: Are they still where they’re supposed to be?
: I sure hope so. That’s 50%% of her job.
: Will you guys stop loitering and yapping if I just let you in for free?
: Free? Why? My card is right here.
: It’s not like anyone else is going to rent it out. Just think of it as a special discount for coming here without Sensei this time.
: Is...Is Io doing something nice for us?
: No.
: I think she is, financially stable Rin.
: I’m not. It’s just a discount. Now please take your financial stability into the bath and leave me alone.
: Whatever it is...thank you, Io. That’s really sweet.
: It’s really not. You’ve rented out the whole thing enough to know the actual price by now.
: I have, yeah. But, could you do me a favor and run this card anyway? For whatever amount you want. I’m pretty sure my dad forgot I exist, so this is my gentle way of reminding him.
: When you put it that way, yes.
: That’ll be 5,000,000 yen.
: Here you go. I don’t need a receipt.
: Good, because we don’t have a printer.
: You must really hate your dad, Ayane. That’s a lot of money.
: I am so fucking tired of smooth jazz, Rin. Ami and Maya are the only ones who understand.
: Yeah, you’ve already lost me. Where are they, by the way? I thought they were gonna meet us here.
: Sorry. I think I broke your card by trying to put 1,000,000,000 on it. It just keeps getting declined now.
: Even better. Thanks, Io. And financially stable Rin, Ami and Maya will be here soon. They’re coming from Sensei’s place, so-
: Sorry. Can you just go back to “Rin” now? All of this “financially stable” stuff is making it feel like I’m bragging.
: Can both of you go back to not being here? I did my part and I would like the yapping to cease now.
: Yup! Come on, regular Rin! Come on, everybody else! Let’s all get naked and look at each other!
: Easy for you to say when your body looks like it was sculpted by the gods.
: We’re all beautiful in our ways, Rin. I just like seeing all of you blossom into lovely young women.
: For a straight girl, you sure say a lot of really gay stuff.
: There’s nothing gay about wanting to see your friends naked.
: I’m glad I heard that now and not in middle school or younger Rin would have been even more confused about what was going on in her head.
: All that matters is that you’re perfect now.
: Mhm. Thanks.
: Futaba, do you have any sort of bath plans?
: What is a “bath plan?”
: Like a plan for what you’re going to do in the bath.
: Well, I was really hoping to practice my swimming tonight.
: Damn it. Okay. Never mind then.
: Heeey! Sorry we’re late! Maya only chooses to watch weird, avant garde movies and whatever we watched tonight went on way longer than I thought it would. Bath time!
: I regret nothing. Bath time seconded.
: Rin...I’m not actually planning on practicing my swimming tonight. What do you want to ask me?
: Can we talk with, like...just the two of us when we get in? No homo.
: For the millionth time, you don’t need to say “no homo” any time you want to talk to me in the bath and/or shower.
: But that leaves the possibility for me to homo at you when you’re least expecting it.
: I don’t think “homo” is a verb.
: It is when you’re aggressively bisexual and suck at flirting.
: Fair. Either way, yes. We can talk. Something specific on your mind?
: Poooooossibly?...
: Okay. I think I’ve got a feeling I know what it is then.
: Nuh-uh. I’m too cool and mysterious for you to predict something like that.
: Yeah, I definitely know what it is.
: No way. You-
: Dear...God.
: Tsuneyo? She’s beautiful, isn’t she?
: Close my eyes. I’m about to homo.
: Feast your eyes upon what can only be referred to as “peak performance,” girls of 1-A.
: Humble as always, Kendo Princess.
: Woof.
: Ayane...do you ever think-
: No.
: I didn’t even say anything yet!
: I know. But comparing your body to Tsuneyo’s will only end in pain. You’re two different types of girls and that’s totally okay!
: I repeat. Woof.
: F...Flat girls are good too! Right, Molly?!
: Precisely, Arborea! We need not the endowment of Hera when Aphrodite exists! Assuming that...Hera was more endowed. Which I assume she was because of the whole “fertility” thing.
: Everyone loves small breasts until their children starve to death from lack of milk.
: Breast size has nothing to do with milk production, actually. And you can all borrow some of my books on motherhood and childcare if you’d like to confirm that for yourselves.
: Lies. All it takes is common sense to realize there would be no real estate for milk storage in a body like Arborea’s. Xessaxia is clearly the most fit to be a mother here.
: Hahah...hah...no, I...think Ayane is still the most fit out of any of us...
: Have I mentioned “woof” recently? Because-
: We get it! You want the Kendo Princess! We all do!
: Futaba, carry me to the bath. I can’t look at her or I’ll cum.
: Ew! Rin!
: Just carry me!
: No! Carry yourself! With your...legs!
: That’s called “walking,” idiot!
: Never fear, Nithhala. I will carry you. It will be just like when I saved the city from the death ball.
: Don’t compare me to the death ball!!!!!
: Hah...I needed this. I’ve been so stressed lately, you don’t even know.
: So, are we going to talk about how you’re in love with Sensei now? Or do you want to soak for a little longer first?
: I am not!
: Oh, sorry. What was it you wanted to talk about then?
: That...
: I need help with our algebra homework!
: Rin...
: Okay, fine! I-
: Shh...screaming it at the top of your lungs defeats the purpose of talking alone, doesn’t it?
: Mmm...
: Take your time. We’re not getting kicked out any time soon.
: I know...it’s just...

: It’s weird when everyone else notices your feelings before you do. And ever since you guys all accused me of wanting to fuck him at the Christmas party, I haven’t been able to stop thinking about it.
: About...specifically having sex with him? Or your feelings for him in general?
: I don’t even know. That’s the problem.
: Like, you’re obviously my best friend. But Sensei is my “best” friend. My homie.
: He’s been with me through practically everything since high school started and, do I frequently imagine his penis inside of me? Yes. But should I receive said penis? Absolutely not. No way. Nuh uh.
: I just can’t stop thinking about him.
: You’ve always done that, Rin.
: Get penised? I certainly have not. Not by anyone real, at least. Even Otoha only used her hands and mouth and-
: I...do not need to know the details of that. What I meant was that you always get hung up on whoever you’re currently into. And right now, that person is obviously Sensei.
: But it shouldn’t be. He’s old. That’s weird.
: You do realize you’re speaking to someone who has been “penised” by him many times, right?
: Yeah! So why are you being supportive of me right now? Isn’t this a major betrayal? And not just to you either. To Chika. Ayane. Ami. Everyone else who loves him.
: Why can’t I just like Uta or Kirin or something? That’d be so much easier.
: Yeah, but that’s not how it works. And I don’t think of it as a betrayal at all. I’ve never for a second imagined being exclusive with Sensei.
: Futaba. Come on.
: Okay, sorry. What I meant to say was I never imagined such a thing would be possible. Not with someone like me at least.
: I really don’t like it when you say things like that. You’re the most beautiful, amazing person I’ve ever met and Sensei would be lucky to have you.
: He’d be lucky to have you too. And if you actually have feelings for him, I think you’re better off acting on them rather than just giving everyone else a shot instead.
: Maybe. But there’s the fear of fucking things up too. I don’t want to ruin the relationship I already have with him because it’s...honestly, one of the best things that’s ever happened to me.
: Which is...embarrassing and...weird to say about a guy who’s over twice my age. But it’s the truth. So maybe it’s best if I just...you know...keep waiting. For someone else to catch my eye.

: Well, do you think you’re capable of that now that your feelings are out in the open? Or do you think you’re going to cave and confess to him on the beach like you have with your past two love interests?
: I doubt I’ll last until the beach if a confession is coming. I literally can not stop thinking about him lately. It’s almost as bad as I was with Chika. My poor vibrator is going to explode.
: Again, don’t need details like that.

: Well, you’re getting them because I don’t know who else to talk to about this. So yeah, stress level — infinite. Love sucks. Being a teenager sucks. I can’t wait until I’m older and don’t have to deal with all these hormones.
: If you think getting older is going to stop you from being so horny, I’d urge you to take another look at the person you’re falling for this time and see what that’s done for him.
: Please. The last thing I need is more thoughts about him and being horny. Especially when I’m already surrounded by boobs and ready to explode.
: Just fuck him already.
: Futaba! What the heck?! You’re supposed to be my voice of reason, not the horny devil on my shoulder!
: I’m sorry! It’s just...hahah!
: You’re one of what I can only assume is a very small group of girls in our class who hasn’t yet. It doesn’t hurt to give it a shot.
: But you specifically told me it did hurt when he did it with you.
: Well...physically, yes. He is...large. But emotionally, it-
: Actually...it has the potential to be very emotionally painful too considering that...I imagine you want him all to yourself, so...
: So basically, I’m just fucked. And I’m fucked by literally not being fucked. Which is like the worst possible way to be fucked out of all the fucking ways to be fucked.
: Yeah, basically.
: But hey, at least you have your vibrator.
: Mmm...
: At the end of the day, I think it’s important that you act on your feelings rather than trying to hide them for the sake of your friends.
: But of course, that’s just my stance. And I imagine Chika is the one you’re the most terrified of right now given how close you two have become and...how scary she just...naturally is.
: Pbrlblrblrlblrblrll....
: I have no idea what you just tried to say. But I know you well enough to assume it was something else about how you’re mostly just afraid of ruining something.
: Pbrlbrl...

: Well...again, this is just the way I see things...but I don’t think that’s avoidable, Rin. I think you’re going to wind up hurting someone one way or another no matter how desperately you try to avoid it.
: Doing things for yourself isn’t always selfish. Sometimes, it’s what needs to be done if you want to make any progress.

: And if you ever feel like you’re stuck, it’s fine to chalk that up to being young and indecisive. Like, who knows? Maybe in ten years, this will be something the two of us will look back at and laugh about.
: But if, right now, you’re thinking “I hope he’s still with me ten years from now,” that’s never going to happen if you don’t act.
: Pblrlblrlblrl........
: I still have no idea what you’re trying to say.
: Hello. The Emerald Guardian’s weak European body has forced her to flee from the water first. May I join you in drowning Nithhala?
: Pbrlblr!
: Nithhala says “yes please.”
: Excellent. I am very experienced when it comes to dealing out death. I will make sure her departure from this mortal coil is slow and painful, the way it should be.
: Plblrlbr...
: Nithhala says that all you need to do in order to make that happen is sit right where you are without moving.
: ....Pah! How’d you manage to translate all of my waterspeak so perfectly?! I’m supposed to be cool and mysterious!
: You are the least cool and perhaps the least mysterious person I know.
: And you’re supposed to be- oh fuck. I looked at them again.
: You may touch them if you like. I am currently open to sexual experimentation.
: Okay! I’m getting out of the bath now!
: Molly! Where are you?! It’s not safe in there and I understand why you left! It’s not your European body at all! It’s- oh. She’s passed out.
And so Nithhala- err...Rin manages to confront the dark entity that’s been growing inside of her lately.
And while the answers she received were not technically the ones she wanted, they did help her confirm one thing.
